description: An SQL formatter for 16 dialects — paste unreadable SQL, get it laid out, nothing uploaded. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

dialect.description: Which database's syntax to parse it as, one of 16 dialects. "sql" is generic standard SQL and is what to use when unsure; "transactsql" is SQL Server and "plsql" is Oracle.

indent.description: What one level of indentation is: "2" or "4" spaces, or "tab".

keywordCase.description: How keywords are written: "upper" gives SELECT, "lower" gives select, "preserve" leaves each keyword as it was typed.

linesBetweenQueries.description: How many blank lines to leave between statements.

sql.description: The SQL to lay out, one or more statements, at most 500000 characters. It is only reformatted: nothing checks that it would run.

name: sql_formatter
title: SQL Formatter
